name: Traceur
description: A paint with no defensive attributes. Made for parkour enthusiasts.
interestingFacts: Traceur was a special paint available for purchase during the 2013 Masters of Parkour contest.
Unlike other Masters of Parkour paints, once bought, Traceur remained in the Garage of whoever purchased the paint. Future editions of MoP reserved the special paint only for the contest's winners.
Exactly 1 068 597 (one million sixty eight thousand five hundred ninety seven) players bought this paint and currently have it in their Garage.
The paint was available for purchase from June 27 to July 17, 2013.
Just like it says in the description, the paint did not and does not have any special properties.
